name: @absolutejs/marketplace
description: Provider-agnostic marketplace primitives for listings, criteria orders, auctions, trades, and atomic collectible settlement.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --root ./src --outdir dist --sourcemap --target=bun && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
